shortDescription.en: Continuously updated digital archive, GitHub intelligence dashboard, portfolio, and bilingual editorial platform for GitHub Pages.
shortDescription.ar: أرشيف رقمي محدث باستمرار، ولوحة تحليلات GitHub، ومعرض أعمال، ومنصة نشر ثنائية اللغة متوافقة مع GitHub Pages.

fullDescription.en: Designed to replace static one-page developer templates with a modular platform that separates automated GitHub API pipelines from manually curated engineering case studies, articles, and knowledge entries.
fullDescription.ar: صُممت لتجاوز قوالب السيرة الثابتة عبر بنية معيارية تفصل بين البيانات المجمعة آلياً من GitHub والمحتوى الهندسي والتحريري المدار يدوياً.

features: Automated daily GitHub REST & GraphQL synchronization via GitHub Actions
Strict schema separation between automated telemetry and manual portfolio data
Full English (LTR) and Arabic (RTL) bilingual interface with Light, Dark, and Glass themes
Local-first Admin Workspace with JSON schema validation and export
objectives: Maintain an accurate, verifiable public record of repositories, commits, and publications
Operate reliably on static GitHub Pages without exposing credentials or requiring a runtime server
items.problemStatement: Conventional portfolios decay quickly, mix manual writing with fragile client-side API scraping, and expose static templates without verifiable engineering depth.
developmentHistory: 2026-11: Defined modular JSON schemas, GitHub Actions collector, and bilingual UI architecture.
items.architectureOverview: Static frontend reading cached JSON datasets updated by scheduled GitHub Actions, paired with localStorage caching and offline resilience.
releases: v1.0.0 — Initial modular digital hub & GitHub intelligence release
roadmap: Automated printable CV and portfolio export
items.documentation: Includes automated schema validator (scripts/validate-schemas.mjs) and GitHub Actions sync workflow (.github/workflows/sync-github.yml).
